title: Designer Condo w/ Free Parking + Walk to Bars
description:
Welcome to your stylish home base in the heart of Midtown Nashville! This modern condo blends comfort and convenience - perfect for digital nomads and travelers alike. Walkable to live music, bars, and restaurants, this is the perfect spot to experience Nashville like a local. Enjoy a remote work setup with fast internet, whiteboard, monitor, and Bluetooth mouse & keyboard. With free parking and on-site laundry, you’ll have everything you need to work hard and play harder.

The space
🌇 Location, Location, Location

Midtown is one of Nashville’s most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods. You’ll be minutes away from:

🎵 Music Row – home to legendary studios and live music

🍻 Top bars and rooftop lounges

🍴 Local restaurants and cafes

📍 Quick uber or scooter ride to Broadway, The Gulch, and Vanderbilt University

✈️ 10 min from BNA Airport

💼 Remote Work Friendly

Dedicated workspace with monitor, whiteboard, Bluetooth keyboard + mouse & speaker

🌐 High speed internet for fast, reliable connection

🎯 Inspiring decor designed for focus and creativity

📸  Stylish, comfortable interior with curated decor and modern, insta-worthy touch

🛏️Comfy king-sized memory foam bed with designer linens and blackout curtains

✔ Pull-out sofa bed with extra pillows and bedding for additional guest

📺 Smart TV with streaming apps (Hulu, Netflix, etc.)

Amenities You’ll Love. Everything you need is right here—including a few Midtown perks:

🚗 Free secure, on-site parking (a rare find in this area!) + optional street side parking steps away

🧺 On-site laundry for longer stays + ironing board/iron, hairdryer, make-up mirror

🍽️ Fully stocked kitchen with designer cookware, coffee maker, and essentials: including complimentary laundry and dishwasher pods

🔐 Keyless entry for easy check-in and secure access
✔ Verified smart lock check-in
✔ 4 PM check-in | 11 AM check-out

📩 Have questions? Message us, we respond fast & love sharing local tips!

Guest access
Seamless Arrival & Effortless Stay
- Instant smart lock access: Auto-generated codes for a stress-free check-in
- Self check-in from 3 PM | Simple check-out by 11 AM
- Key to laundry room in the building provided

Other things to note
HOA Rules
- No pets, smoking, drugs, or firearms.
- No parties or large gatherings.
- Use only the assigned parking space.
- Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM.

Violations may result in fines or termination of your stay. The building is home to several permanent residents so thank you for respecting the rules!

 Early Check-In / Late Check-Out
- Our most common request is for flexibility with check-in and check-out times. 
- We will do our best to accommodate you, but unable to guarantee your request due to high demand and time required for cleaning between guests.
- Please book an extra night to guarantee your plans!
